title: Simple Teleportation - Add RPG Maker 2000 style teleport and escape (Ver.1.0.2)

posts.author: Awayamatana
posts.body:
Implement teleport and escape.
https://twitter.com/i/web/status/1905604484707090640
Download
SimpleTeleportation.js
Ver.1.0.2
MIT License
How to Use
You will be able to use teleport to a registered location and escape to escape from dungeons, etc.
Please change [Scope] and [Occasion] as appropriate.
[Note (Items/Skills)]
<teleport> //Effect [Teleport]
<escape> //Effect [Escape]
Specifications
If the [Effects] contains a Common Event, teleportation or escape will not occur.
Instead, you can use the plugin command [Get Teleport Position] to get the information into variables, allowing you to create your own teleport/escape effects.
